selection: Unique prompts (case/whitespace-normalised) of <= 40 words containing an explicit count (once|twice|thrice|<number> times/taps/knocks/steps/shots/beats/clicks/hits) or a sequence connective (then|followed by|and finally|until|after that|afterwards). Manually excluded: 'once' meaning 'at once'/'as soon as', non-contact audio captions (speech, animal calls, music), exact duplicates kept only if wording differs.
annotation: DRAFT by the assistant from the literal text; to be reviewed by the researcher. contacts = number of discrete short (<=0.6 s, cut) vibration events, [lo, hi] inclusive or null if not scored. continuous = a sustained (>=0.5 s) segment is expected (true), must not exist (false) or not scored (null). phases = ordered keyword groups; each group must match some sub-event prompt (lowercase substring) and the earliest matches must occur in this order. intensity = 'decrease' | 'increase' | 'last_strongest' over the scored short events. interval_s = expected spacing between repeated short events [lo, hi].
